Season 14 starts with a bang! Megh, Vatsal and friend of the pod Richa (from @PCCIpod) are joined by Dr. Himanish Ganjoo (@himganj153). In this two part conversation, we cover Himanish’s academic journey, love for cosmology and cricket analytics. 
Part 1👇🏽

When I was considering a PhD abroad, my mother weighed in with “Saraswathi lives where a culture supports knowledge. India is not her abode anymore. You must go where She is”.

They are brazen because they know they operate in that culture, and you are silent for the same reason.
"NO BINDI NO BUSINESS 😠😡" bros when someone they don't like actually wears one.

This episode is still as relevant as it was in 2023.
